title: Notification policy
help: Applies only to new events. Approval and budget alerts are critical and always bypass filtering and merging. Only identical frozen messages for the same resource merge; this is not a summary. Saving does not enable the channel or send a message.
mergedHelp: Not sent separately; inspect the original delivery outcome:
filteredHelp: Not sent because the frozen subscription threshold excluded this event.
conflict: The notification policy changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Reload the current policy (discarding this draft) before editing again.
